meta.title: Siaya County: Auditor-General findings tracker
meta.rule: Findings are the auditor's findings, not legal conclusions. Titles are short neutral paraphrases. No individuals are named; offices and entities only. Loaded words appear only inside report_heading, quoted and marked.

entities.county_government: County Government of Siaya (executive and assembly together; FY 2013/14 16-month audit only)

meta.recurrence_rule: Recurrence is counted per category and year. A finding is linked to an earlier one only when the report says it is unresolved from a prior year, the next report lists it as unresolved, or the same named contract or requirement reappears (same_items). Counts per category are not evidence that a specific finding recurred.
meta.amounts_rule: Amounts are as printed in KSh (decimals kept where printed). Each amount carries the report's own label; amounts within one finding are not summed.
meta.pages: PDF page numbers of the downloaded file, not printed page numbers.
meta.method: Read by hand from the PDF text layer (pdftotext) or, for FY 2024/25, tesseract OCR of page images. Amounts that were illegible are left out with a note.
